quest.title: A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night!
quest.description: Until the sun rises once more...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night!

talks.objective: Return to the resort accommodation and rest

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, let's get some rest.

talks.objective: Return to the resort accommodation and rest

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Morning {NICKNAME}, morning Paimon! Thought I'd come over and say hi, puffer floaters and all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Morning, Mualani! How are you so full of energy? Weren't you the one partying the hardest last night!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That was last night! I got a good night's sleep, and now I'm good as new!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Here, take this. It's your prize for completing the album — I picked yours up too, to save you the trip!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Thanks, Mualani! That was so nice!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: When it comes to helping people, a good guide always thinks one step ahead, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, and speaking of work, I guess our vacation's almost over, huh... Probably for the best. If I don't head back soon, I'm worried my little doggie won't even remember me.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: And after talking to the others, it seems like everyone is just about ready to get back.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Some are missing their families, others are going through Dandelion Wine withdrawal, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Even Chasca seems to be feeling it. Not that she'd ever admit it, but I have noticed her gazing back towards the Flower-Feather Clan at night.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I completely understand...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But summer's not over yet! So I say... we squeeze a few more unforgettable moments into the time we've got left!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Like another group photo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, how about taking one right here? After all this time, Paimon's grown kind of attached to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Great idea! Why don't you spruce up this wall, and I'll go gather the others. See you over at the plaza!

talks.objective: Spray-paint according to your companions' ideas
Spray-paint according to your companions' ideas

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wow, that looks amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Guys, over here! We're gonna take a picture together!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Not bad, not bad! You're all looking full of energy this morning — not a trace of bed head or dark circles in sight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you even look out for stuff like that?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well, what kind of guide would I be if I didn't pay attention to the details?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Yeah, and what kind of bard would I be if I didn't appreciate a good drink?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What's that got to do with anything!?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Somehow, though, I know exactly what he means!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Friends that talk nonsense together, stay together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you really think that? Or are you just playing along to keep Tone-Deaf Bard happy too?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I see no harm in a bit of nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Here, put on this Asha headband. It's a souvenir from the rest of us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It really suits you!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alrighty then...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, all that nonsense has got Paimon's head muddled. Her mind's gone completely blank...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Don't want it all to end, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Are you worried, once you say those words, the vacation will officially be over?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How the... Paimon thought Peacemakers couldn't read people's minds!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Haha, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Summer's sure to come again, just like you said when you made that wish to the Pyro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Even though we'll all be going our separate ways, as long as we cherish each other's friendship, I just know that our paths will cross again.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Bennett's becoming quite the talker, huh, Professor Venti?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, well, I wouldn't dare take credit for something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your tone would suggest otherwise... C'mon, Paimon was just starting to feel inspired...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Why don't we just give it another try?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's do it all together this time!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Huh. What should we shout?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lucky star?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds good!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Everyone
dialogues.text: Lucky star!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You have a wonderful time with your friends...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: ...So, what are your plans for the future, Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: If you're having trouble deciding, you can always park it in the People of the Springs for a bit, or however long you want, really.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Thanks for the kind offer, Mualani.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I actually went to see the Pyro Archon to tell her how grateful I am for everything she's done for me.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: She told me that the Domain we entered was an Abyssal simulation of the Mare Jivari. It was extremely unstable, and now it's completely gone.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Later, when we got onto talking about my future, she said I was more than welcome to stay here in Natlan... but also that she would respect my decision, whatever it turned out to be.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And after thinking it over, long and hard... I've decided to return to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: You miss your dads, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: That's definitely part of it. I promised to tell them everything that happened on this adventure, and I can't go back on my word.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But also...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: When I said goodbye to my mom and dad, I promised them I'd become the most legendary adventurer in all of Teyvat someday.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And no adventurer should stay in one place for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Bennett...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What if your luck starts going downhill again the moment you leave Natlan?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, it's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The warmth and kindness I've experienced on this adventure is enough to get me through all the challenges that lie ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: As I attempt to shape my own fate, I want to take that same kindness and pass it forward. That's something I've always believed in.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hear, hear! To our leader!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: To our leader, Bennett!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Cheers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... This is gonna be another all-nighter, isn't it...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hehe, the fun never stops! Who's up to perform next?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Bennett's almost fallen asleep several times now...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: No, no... I can still... keep going...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Go get some rest now, guys. And seeing as you've still got the energy, I'll leave the clean-up to you, Mualani...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Huh? Why me...?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, perhaps you could join me for a walk?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I know a great spot.

talks.objective: Go to the place Venti mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You might be tone-deaf, but you sure know how to sniff out a good view...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, glad you like it. Some stories aren't meant for the birds — only for the stars high in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Time for a bedtime story?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha... More like a story that begins with "Time" itself.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Long, long ago, "Ti{RUBY#[D]Istaroth}me" began to write the story of this world.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: To her, all living beings were equal, both in their value and insignificance.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Like an ancient scroll, she engraved upon her memory all people, all events, all encounters, and all farewells.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Back then, as an Anemo spirit, I had a chance encounter with "Time" at the Thousand Winds Temple.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hearing my wishes, she entrusted me with fragments of her power and authority...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Sounds like you've heard the story of "Time and the Wind" before.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Charming, isn't it?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Through the memories engraved in rituals, poems, ruins, and ancient texts, the same beings she considered so insignificant have met her... time and time again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this is the story you wanted to share?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Mmm... More like the prologue.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The corruption of the Mare Jivari is tied to time itself. To put it another way, it is a calamity present in every moment that will ever be.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Unlike "Time" herself, I have always cherished many wishes in my heart.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Five hundred years ago, to prevent the corruption of the Mare Jivari from spreading beyond Tenochtzitoc...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...I blew it off the timeline, turning it into the "Windless Land."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So that's the truth behind the Mare Jivari's disappearance?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oops, seems like I may have confused you...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: If you're asking about how the Mare Jivari disappeared from Tenochtzitoc two or three decades ago, there may be someone else better suited to tell that story.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The Mare Jivari has been the bearer of too many stories that weren't meant to be its own... I merely played a part in one of its chapters.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: And the choice I made five hundred years ago came with a price.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Some souls were unable to return to Mondstadt as a result... while others stayed to settle in this land, merging with the Monetoo to become the Asha we see today.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the reason you're here in Tenochtzitoc is because...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Correct. I'm here to collaborate with the current Pyro Archon, Mavuika.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean when we lit up that candle...?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Correct again. The flame was our signal.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Only by having Mavuika open a rift between that space and the true Mare Jivari could I sneak in and bring back all the souls who wished to return.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: As for my little trick of bringing back memories as well... Heh, it's not the first time I've pulled that off.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Mavuika also mentioned that you were planning to introduce us... Looks like I beat you to it, huh?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I was glad to discover that she shares my love for fine wine and freedom. We got along great.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Well, it really took it out of me for a few days... In fact, I still feel pretty dead on my feet even now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, really?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But, thinking of all the Aphimead and Dandelion Wine still left to drink... I suppose I can hang in there a little longer.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't look that tired to Paimon, so don't think you can just pull out that little excuse and we'll suddenly foot all your bills!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh how you wound me, Paimon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Venti...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #You'll hook me up with some good liquor, won't you, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I suppose... to protect Mondstadt, and that everyone who wishes to stay there has the freedom to choose their own path.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Time to rest?)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: If we spray the top layer with orange, I bet it'd look great!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The colors of the Flower-Feather Clan should make a good fit...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: A blue hue would be a lucky color for this little cabin!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What do you think about using light green over here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants it to be bright yellow!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sweet!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Fits as well as I thought it would.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Our lucky little cabin!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What a nice, breezy color.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon expected nothing less from you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a little longer.
